units.text: ⟦0⟧11 Tips for Making and Using Patches⟦1⟧
units.sourceHTML: 11 Tips for Making and Using Patches

units.text: Use some common sense when making and using patches. For example, when sending bug fixes to a program’s maintainer, send several small patches, one per independent subject, instead of one large, harder-to-digest patch that covers all the subjects.
units.sourceHTML: Use some common sense when making and using patches. For example, when sending bug fixes to a program’s maintainer, send several small patches, one per independent subject, instead of one large, harder-to-digest patch that covers all the subjects.

units.text: Here are some other things you should keep in mind if you are going to distribute patches for updating a software package.
